MENU_QUICK_DESC: Two teams, one ground. Play now.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Eight countries, two groups, one trophy.
MENU_CAREER_DESC: Create a player. Go under the hammer. Build a legacy.
HINT_RAID: Tap Cant on the beat; every move counts as a beat too. Cross the baulk line, touch defenders, then get back over the midline.
HINT_DEFEND: Hold your shape. Press Chain to link hands with a team-mate, then tackle as the raider turns for home.
HINT_DOD: Do-or-die raid: score a point or the raider is out.
NAME: Name
YOU_UNSOLD: You went unsold. {team} sign you at base price.
CAREER_HINT_RAIDER: You take your team's raids. On defence you play your own position.
CAREER_HINT_DEFENDER: You anchor the defence. Your team's AI raiders take the raids.
QUALIFY_NOTE: Top two in each group reach the semi-finals.
HOW_RAID: Raiding: run into their half, cross the baulk line and touch defenders with a hand or toe touch. Get back over the midline before the raid ends: before the 30-second clock runs out, or on one breath with the cant. Every defender you touched is out.
HOW_DEFEND: Defending: move your highlighted defender and choose your tackle when the raider is close: Ankle hold, Thigh hold or Waist hold. Team-mates pile in. Stop the raider reaching the midline.
HOW_BONUS: Bonus: with six or more defenders on the mat, get a foot over the bonus line while the other foot is off the ground. Stepping over counts, and so does stretching a leg across with Kick (an airborne bonus).
HOW_DOD: Do or die: after two empty raids in a row, the next raid must score or the raider is out.
HOW_ALLOUT: All out: put the whole opposing team out for two extra points. They all come back.
HOW_REVIVE: Revival: each point you score brings one of your out players back, in the order they went out.
HOW_CONTROLS: Controls: your left thumb moves; touch anywhere on the left half for a joystick. Your right thumb works the action buttons. Drag anywhere else to look around. The top-right button switches between the third-person and broadcast cameras.
ARENA_DOME_DESC: Indoor pro arena. Blue mat, big lights, loud crowd.
ARENA_VILLAGE_DESC: Mud court on the village ground at golden hour.
ARENA_STADIUM_DESC: Floodlit international stadium, made for big nights.
ARENA_MONSOON_DESC: Wet mat under monsoon rain in Kochi.
ARENA_BEACH_DESC: Sand court by the sea. Beach kabaddi rules.
PLACEHOLDER_NOTE: Placeholder athletes. Drop real character models into assets/characters to replace them.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Slow defenders who wind up early, a wide cant window, generous aim assist.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Balanced. Defenders punish careless touches; the cant needs a steady rhythm.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Sharp chains and quick tackles. A tight cant window and smart AI raiders.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Elite defence that reads your every feint. Miss a beat and you lose the cant.
HINT_NO_PARTNER: No team-mate close enough to link hands.
MENU_SEASON_DESC: Own a franchise. Win the auction, the league and the final.
SEASON_AUCTION_INTRO: Your best six are retained. Use the rest of your purse at the auction to build a squad of up to 12, then chase the title.
PLAYOFF_NOTE: Top six reach the playoffs: 3rd v 6th and 4th v 5th in the eliminators, 1st and 2nd wait in the semi-finals.

TUT_CANT_1: Raiders must keep chanting “kabaddi”. Tap Cant as the ring closes on the button.
TUT_CANT_2: Keep chanting and run into the other half.
TUT_CANT_3: Still chanting? Cross the baulk line.
TUT_TOUCH_1: Get close to a defender and press Hand touch.
TUT_TOUCH_2: Now get back over the midline to score.
TUT_TOE_1: Stretch a leg out: press Toe touch near a defender. It reaches further than a hand.
TUT_BONUS_1: With six or more defenders on the mat, cross the bonus line.
TUT_ESCAPE_1: These defenders tackle. When one grabs you, tap Dodge to break free.
TUT_TACKLE_1: You're defending. Wait for the raider to come close or turn for home, then press Ankle hold.
TUT_CHAIN_1: Press Chain to link hands with the team-mate next to you.
TUT_CHAIN_2: Linked defenders go in together. Tackle the raider.
HOW_CANT: Raid rules (Settings). 30-second clock, the Pro rule: no chant; get back before the raid clock runs out. The cant, the traditional rule: the raider chants “kabaddi, kabaddi” on a single breath with no clock. Tap Cant in rhythm; if the chant breaks while you're in their half, or your breath runs out there, you're out. Fitter raiders hold a longer breath.
HOW_CHAIN: Chains: defenders link hands to make tackles stronger. Press Chain to join the nearest team-mate; you move slower together but hit harder.
TUT_KICK_1: Get a defender beside or behind you, then press Kick to lash out at him. Kick at someone in front and it's a toe touch.
TUT_DUBKI_1: Defenders link hands in pairs. Run at the joined hands and press Dubki to duck under them.
TUT_LION_1: These defenders dive low at your ankles. When one crouches to go in, press Lion jump to leap over him.
HOW_MOVES: Raiding moves: Hand touch and Kick score. Kick is a toe touch at a defender in front, or a back or side kick at one behind or beside you. To get away, Dodge sidesteps, Dubki ducks under high tackles and linked hands, and Lion jump leaps over low dives at your ankles. Every player rates differently at each move; his best is his signature, and he uses it most.
HOW_STYLES: Defensive skills: an ankle hold goes low (a lion jump clears it), thigh and waist holds go high (a dubki ducks under them). A waist hold lifts the raider, even out of a jump, so he can't push. A block happens when he runs straight into you while you're set. A dash shoves him over a line, so use it near the side or end line. Chains get stronger with chain rating. Every player rates differently; his best is his signature tackle and the AI uses it most. On Rookie and Pro, Dash and Waist hold light up when they're the right call.
TUT_WAIST_1: Press Waist hold as the raider comes close. It lifts him off his feet, so he can't push for the line, and it catches him even in mid-jump.
TUT_DASH_1: This raider loves the bonus line out wide. When he's near the side line, press Dash to shove him out.
RAID_RULE_NOTE: 30-second clock is the Pro rule: no chant, just beat the raid clock. The cant is the traditional rule: the raider chants “kabaddi” on one breath, with no clock, and is out if the chant breaks in the other half.
HINT_RAID_CLOCK: Cross the baulk line, touch defenders, then get back over the midline before the 30-second clock runs out.
HINT_RAID_AUTO: Your raider chants on one breath. Sprinting and moves use it up faster. Cross the baulk line, touch defenders, and get back before it runs out.
HOW_TIEBREAK: Drawn knockouts: all seven players come back and each team gets five raids by five different raiders. Still level? A coin toss, then golden raids: the baulk line counts as the bonus line, and the first raid that scores wins it.
HOW_LINES: Lines and lobbies: step out of the court before any contact and you're out; once there's been contact the lobbies (side strips) are in play. Defenders who cross the midline into the raider's half are out, and so is a defender whose dive or dash carries him out.
TIMEOUT_CALLED: Time out called: it starts after this raid
HOW_ENERGY: Energy and time outs: raids, dives and struggles tire players; they recover between raids, faster on the bench, and at half time. Tired raiders are slower and tired defenders hold less well. Each team has two 30-second time outs per half (the bar and TO count under each team's name). Call yours from the pause menu; it happens after the current raid.
ARJUNA_SUB: Most valuable player of the season
ARJUNA_YOURS: Yours! The Arjuna Award comes home.
ARJUNA_NOTE: Points count from every match of the season, playoffs included. In real life the Arjuna Award is India's national sports honour, given by the sports ministry for years of excellence; here it crowns the season's best player.
HINT_FIVE_SECONDS: Go! A raid must start within 5 seconds of the whistle.
EV_LATE_RAID: Too slow to start: technical point
HOW_SWITCH: Switch takes you to the defender nearest the raider; press it again quickly for the next one. You can also tap any of your defenders to take him over, before or during a raid.
HOW_CARDS: Rough play costs you. A green card is a warning. A second offence is a yellow card: two minutes off the mat and a technical point to the other side.
HOW_FIVE: A raider must start his raid within 5 seconds of the whistle, or the other side gets a technical point.
HOW_MILESTONES: Ten raid points in a match is a Super 10. Five tackle points is a High 5.
GFX_LOWERED: Graphics set to {level} for smoother play
RULE_CLOCK_NOTE: The Pro rule. No chant: cross, touch and get back before the 30-second raid clock runs out.
RULE_TAP_NOTE: Tap Cant on the beat to keep chanting. Every move you make counts as a beat, so pressing Touch or Dubki never breaks the cant.
RULE_BREATH_NOTE: The traditional rule, hands free. Your raider chants by himself on one breath. Sprinting, moves and struggling in a hold use it up faster. Run out in their half and you're out.
TUT_CANT_1_BREATH: Your raider chants by himself on one breath. Watch the bar: sprinting and moves use it up.
